AgentCommand.description: A command the user can type in a Claude session: `/name`.

id.description: The tool call that started it.

detail.description: The command, or the subagent's type.

status.description: Lost: no end notice, and nothing runs it any more: still running a day on (gone with its session), or a command whose output has gone silent with no process holding it open.

runId.description: A workflow's run: its journal and record beside the session.

resumedAt.description: A subagent sent a message after it had finished: Claude Code resumes it under the same id, with no new start record, and notifies again when it stops. When that last happened.

taskId.description: Background task or agent id, as notifications name it.

agentId.description: A subagent's conversation: subagents/agent-<id>.jsonl beside the session.

parentAgentId.description: Started by one of the session's subagents: that subagent's agent id.

parent.description: That subagent's name (or what it was started for).

foreign.description: Not started by this conversation: listed from a message it sent the agent (resuming it) or from the agent's end notice.

rewound.description: Started in a part of the conversation a rewind took back. Listed only while it still runs (a teammate also while idle): what it did is gone from the conversation, not the work it goes on doing.

foreground.description: A command run in the foreground that has not answered yet: what the turn waits on now. Never a background task.

AgentTask.description: What a Claude session ran on the side: background commands, monitors and subagents, with how each ended. Read from the transcript: the tool call that started it, its result (task or agent id, output file), and the task notification Claude Code adds when it ends.

id.description: The tool call that started it.

status.description: Lost: no end notice, and nothing runs it any more: still running a day on (gone with its session), or a command whose output has gone silent with no process holding it open.

resumedAt.description: A subagent sent a message after it had finished: Claude Code resumes it under the same id, with no new start record, and notifies again when it stops. When that last happened.

rewound.description: Started in a part of the conversation a rewind took back. Listed only while it still runs (a teammate also while idle): what it did is gone from the conversation, not the work it goes on doing.

AgentTaskSummary.description: What the Workspaces list shows of a task: no output, no long summaries.

PublishedArtifact.description: A page an agent published with Claude Code's Artifact tool.

SessionArtifact.description: An artifact as the session left it: its last publish.

startedAt.description: When it started, in ms since the epoch.

lastActiveAt.description: While it runs: when its conversation last changed.

result.description: Once it has ended: its record's result, shortened.
